## Context

- Scope widened on the product owner's instruction (2026-10-30): the review covers 687410e..e3736d1 (27 commits, one identity), including b33793a..e3736d1, which already landed the overdue-audit start gate, loop tests through the gates and the docs; for those this card reviews and corrects existing code rather than building it. Two observations for the review: b33793a swept card 205's uncommitted red test (PENDING(205-1), written by the card 205 QA red seat) into a commit with another subject and no card record, and rewrote tests/test_card_mode.py whole; facilitator.py now has CRLF line endings.

- Audit 17 found the 14 commits (19:48 to 21:39 PDT, 2026-10-29) all by one identity, six landing in six seconds, with no Decider, votes file, review record, task force, probes or domain-expert answer; the tests were written by the same session. Audit 18 added seven more (b67b977..df8cdd6) with the same single author. This breaks independence of review, whole-team and accountability for a shared template that every mob inherits.
- The deliverables are records in git: the Decider record, the votes file, the re-run record and the review record. No code is written, so there is no red test; the checks are on the records.
- Left to other cards: 209 and 210 change code and are reviewed on their own cards. Any defect this review finds is raised as a new finding and a new corrective card, not fixed here.
